title: Integrability of a centered Gaussian density
statement: Let $\mu\in\mathbb{R}$ and let $v\ge 0$ be a nonzero real parameter. The function $x\mapsto (x-\mu)g_{\mu,v}(x)$ is integrable on $\mathbb{R}$, where $g_{\mu,v}$ is the Gaussian density with mean $\mu$ and parameter $v$.
